newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Mexican crude ports shut because of high winds.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexican crude ports shut because of high winds.

text.p: Two of Mexico's three main shipping ports were closed on Wednesday because of a cold front in the area, port officials told Reuters.
Pajaritos port, located in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz state, closed at 0730 local/1330 GMT Monday amid winds of 50 to 60 km per hour, port representatives said.
In Tabasco state, Dos Bocas was shut at 0820/1420 as wind speeds hit between 25 and 35 km per hour.
Dos Bocas was again shut after it reopened at 1500/2100 on Monday. A new cold front hit the area and closed eight ports along the Gulf of Mexico.
The port captain at the nation's most important crude shipping port, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, said the port remained open with light rains.
